PESTICIDES ACT 1974

PESTICIDES (LICENSING FOR MANUFACTURING) (AMENDMENT) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 57(1) of the Pesticides Act 1974 [Act 149],

the Minister, after consultation with the Board, makes the following rules:

Citation

1. These rules may be cited as the Pesticides (Licensing for Manufacturing)

(Amendment) Rules 2020.

Amendment of national language text

2. Pesticides (Licensing for manufacturing) Rules 2011 [P.U. (A) 187/2011], referred to

in as the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended in the national language text, in

paragraphs 4(1)(a) and (b) and subrule 10(2), by substituting for the word "pendaftar" the

words "orang yang mendaftar".

Amendment of rule 10

3. Subrule 10(2) of the principal Rules is amended by substituting for the words

"subrule 6(b)" the words "paragraph 4(1)(b)".

Substitution of Second Schedule

4. The principal Rules are amended by substituting for theSecond Schedule the following

schedule:
